title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and comply with mask-wearing over time under social influence, policies, and information campaigns.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People influence each other's mask attitudes and compliance via social network ties; stronger ties and homophily increase influence.

interactions.name: contact_event
interactions.description: People meet at locations; observed norms and peers' mask use affect subsequent adoption decisions and immediate compliance.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and organizations enforce mask policies; individuals may face penalties or reminders, affecting compliance probability.

interactions.name: information_broadcast
interactions.description: Organizations and media broadcast messages that shift risk perception, trust, and mask attitudes.

interactions.name: policy_setting
interactions.description: Organizations set or adjust mask policies at locations (e.g., mask required vs. recommended).

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks consistently at each timestep.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 60%, 80%).

metrics.name: peak_and_steady_state_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption achieved and adoption level after stabilization.

metrics.name: compliance_distribution
metrics.description: Distribution of individual compliance probabilities and mask statuses across the population.

metrics.name: policy_impact
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates attributable to policy enforcement and penalties versus baseline.

metrics.name: norms_effect
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to observed norms at locations and social network effects.

metrics.name: equity_gap
metrics.description: Differences in adoption rates across demographic or risk groups.

metrics.name: masked_contact_fraction
metrics.description: Proportion of person-to-person contacts where both parties are masked.
